name: The Bus Stop
source:
You check your watch. The bus is late.

You catch a stranger watching you from across the street. Or are you watching them?

[From [url=https://hamstaregg.itch.io/the-bus-stop]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你检查一下手表。公共汽车晚点了。

你发现一个陌生人在街对面看着你。或者你在观察他们吗？

[来自[url=https://hamstaregg.itch.io/the-bus-stop]Itch.io[/url]]
